notes: New: A Layers panel lists everything you add to a snap. Drag layers to reorder them, delete them, or collapse the panel to icons only.
New: Group layers together so they move, resize and turn as one. Use Ctrl+G to group and Ctrl+Shift+G to ungroup.
New: Select several marks at once by Ctrl+clicking them on the picture or in the Layers panel. You can then move, resize, turn, copy, paste or delete them together.
New: Layer up and Layer down buttons, plus Ctrl+] and Ctrl+[, move a mark above or below the others.
New: An eyedropper in the color menus picks a color from your picture. In the installed app it can pick from anywhere on the screen.
Improved: Changing the outline or fill color now recolors every selected drawing, highlight and shape, not just text.
Improved: Copy and paste now work on several marks at once, and pasted groups stay grouped.
